svg.title: Allocate a $75,000 Reference Startup Budget
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-75000-reference-buyer-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate a $75,000 Reference Startup Budget; subtitle: Four buckets compare $30,000 lean, $75,000 reference, and $120,000 expanded plans.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: The canonical startup-capital range is $30,000–$120,000 USD. The $75,000 central/reference plan allocates 40%, 10%, 30%, and 20% across four buckets. Lean and expanded plans use the same illustrative weights, not claims that every transaction is feasible at either boundary. Size acquisition financing and required liquidity against transaction-specific evidence.; caption: Numeric values are reference-plan USD and sum to $75,000: $30,000 + $7,500 + $22,500 + $15,000. Lean allocations sum to $30,000: $12,000 + $3,000 + $9,000 + $6,000. Expanded allocations sum to $120,000: $48,000 + $12,000 + $36,000 + $24,000. Buyer capital is neither recognized sales nor total enterprise value.; stages: label: Purchase equity contribution; value: Lean $12,000; reference $30,000; expanded $48,000; 40%; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Allocate $12,000 of the $30,000 lean plan, $30,000 of the $75,000 reference plan, and $48,000 of the $120,000 expanded plan. Size debt separately; confirm lender equity requirements and seller-note treatment before treating any note as qualifying injection.; label: Diligence and closing costs; value: Lean $3,000; reference $7,500; expanded $12,000; 10%; numeric value: 7500.0; detail: Allocate $3,000 of the $30,000 lean plan, $7,500 of the $75,000 reference plan, and $12,000 of the $120,000 expanded plan for QoE, counsel, tax work, searches, and transaction expenses. Validate quoted fees before proceeding; separate one-time engagement charges from recurring contractor expense.; label: Opening working-capital reserve; value: Lean $9,000; reference $22,500; expanded $36,000; 30%; numeric value: 22500.0; detail: Allocate $9,000 of the $30,000 lean plan, $22,500 of the $75,000 reference plan, and $36,000 of the $120,000 expanded plan. Fund collection gaps and seasonality after reconciling seller-delivered working capital to the negotiated closing adjustment.; label: Integration and contingency liquidity; value: Lean $6,000; reference $15,000; expanded $24,000; 20%; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Allocate $6,000 of the $30,000 lean plan, $15,000 of the $75,000 reference plan, and $24,000 of the $120,000 expanded plan for migration, retention, and repair contingencies. Cash released for one purpose cannot simultaneously remain available for another.

rect.title: label: Purchase equity contribution; numeric value: 30000.0; value: Lean $12,000; reference $30,000; expanded $48,000; 40%; detail: Allocate $12,000 of the $30,000 lean plan, $30,000 of the $75,000 reference plan, and $48,000 of the $120,000 expanded plan. Size debt separately; confirm lender equity requirements and seller-note treatment before treating any note as qualifying injection.

text.title: Purchase equity contribution: Lean $12,000; reference $30,000; expanded $48,000; 40%
text.tspan: Purchase equity contribution: Lean $12,000; reference $30,000; expanded $48,000; 40%

rect.title: label: Diligence and closing costs; numeric value: 7500.0; value: Lean $3,000; reference $7,500; expanded $12,000; 10%; detail: Allocate $3,000 of the $30,000 lean plan, $7,500 of the $75,000 reference plan, and $12,000 of the $120,000 expanded plan for QoE, counsel, tax work, searches, and transaction expenses. Validate quoted fees before proceeding; separate one-time engagement charges from recurring contractor expense.

text.title: Diligence and closing costs: Lean $3,000; reference $7,500; expanded $12,000; 10%
text.tspan: Diligence and closing costs: Lean $3,000; reference $7,500; expanded $12,000; 10%

rect.title: label: Opening working-capital reserve; numeric value: 22500.0; value: Lean $9,000; reference $22,500; expanded $36,000; 30%; detail: Allocate $9,000 of the $30,000 lean plan, $22,500 of the $75,000 reference plan, and $36,000 of the $120,000 expanded plan. Fund collection gaps and seasonality after reconciling seller-delivered working capital to the negotiated closing adjustment.

text.tspan: Opening working-capital reserve: Lean $9,000; reference $22,500; expanded $36,000; 30%

rect.title: label: Integration and contingency liquidity; numeric value: 15000.0; value: Lean $6,000; reference $15,000; expanded $24,000; 20%; detail: Allocate $6,000 of the $30,000 lean plan, $15,000 of the $75,000 reference plan, and $24,000 of the $120,000 expanded plan for migration, retention, and repair contingencies. Cash released for one purpose cannot simultaneously remain available for another.

Size acquisition financing and required liquidity against transaction-specific evidence.
